sections.Profile:
"Big Top" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. on February 19, 1949. Designed by Harvey Heiss, the game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Circus, Original Theme
